title: Mage Debug Adapter Configuration
description: JSON schema for Mage debug adapter protocol launch and attach configurations

request.description: Launch a new Mage program for debugging

program.description: Path to the Mage source file to debug

args.description: Command line arguments to pass to the program

cwd.description: Working directory for the launched process

stopOnEntry.description: Automatically pause the program after launching

request.description: Attach to a running Mage process

processId.description: The process ID of the running Mage application to attach to

port.description: The debug port to connect to

host.description: The host address to connect to
